content: We further improve by sharing learned word representations in the decoder by tying input and output embeddings (). This configuration performs even better than with a gain of 5.3 BLEU in the 160K setup. Sharing decoder embeddings is equally applicable to . Language model representations are much less effective in the decoder: improves the 160K bitext setup but yields no improvements thereafter and performs even worse. We conjecture that pre-trained representations give much easier wins in the encoder. Table TABREF14 shows additional results on newstest2018.
